the ZnS/Si interface is a complex one which is dominated by the presence of a discrete energy level in the mid-gap.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the sputtered ZnS films are non-stoichiometrical with a high concentration of zinc.
the interface states are not intrinsic to the heterojunction but are introduced during the sputter deposition process.
the sputtered ZnS film is a good p-type window for silicon solar cells.
